title: provenance-aggregator-seeding-and-rollback-safepoints
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Customers running Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments require deterministic rollback points and strong provenance for release artifacts. This PR implements a lightweight provenance aggregator that seeds release manifests with artifact attestations and creates 'rollback safepoints' that the private-installer can use to perform deterministic upgrades and rollbacks. It also adds a validation stage in the CI pipeline that verifies cosign signatures, KMS-backed key rotation metadata, and TUF-compatible provenance blobs before a release is promoted.

What changed: single continuous description string below lists key components committed in this PR — provenance-aggregator service (small Go utility), CI pipeline steps for seeding attestations, helm chart templating knobs to consume safepoints, terraform module updates for installer state bucket lifecycle, and a migration that backfills safepoint metadata for the last two released delta bundles. Included conservative opt-in behavior: private customers must enable 'provenanceSeed=true' in their installer config to activate runtime usage.

Design notes: the aggregator collects cosign attestations emitted by the build pipeline and normalizes them into a compact JSON provenance envelope (artifact_sha, cosign_sig_refs, attestation_payload_refs, build_id, timestamp, signed_by_key_id). These envelopes are uploaded to the installer state bucket under /provenance/{release_tag}/envelopes/*. A small 'safepoint-manifest' is derived that pins a set of artifact SHAs and a signed manifest index (cosigned by the release signing key) that the upgrade/rollback controller can atomically download and validate at runtime. The approach avoids migrating the full SBOM into the installer and keeps per-release provenance lightweight while preserving verifiability.

Migration and safety: added a migration job (CI triggered) that backfills provenance envelopes for the past two release windows. The installer now refuses to apply a rollback across a non-safepoint boundary unless an operator passes --unsafe-allow-migration and acknowledges the audit checklist.

Security and key rotation: integrates with existing KMS binding for cosign key references. A new small helper script records key rotation events as provenance metadata so the controller can reject manifests signed by keys that have been revoked.

CI changes: added two new steps to the release workflow: 1) provenance-seed: aggregates artefacts from the build bucket, verifies cosign signatures and uploads envelopes; 2) safepoint-validate: verifies the new safepoint-manifest cosign signature and runs a TUF-style provenance validator against the envelope set. Both steps run in the private-installer pipeline and are gated behind a feature flag in CI for staged rollout.

Backward compatibility: opt-in by default. Helm chart provides values.provenance.enabled (default false). Terraform module adds an optional state_bucket_prefix variable; existing installs are unaffected unless they opt in.

Testing: unit tests for the aggregator, integration test in the release pipeline that seeds a synthetic release and ensures the installer controller accepts the safepoint-manifest and can simulate an atomic rollback. CI records included test flakiness info and two reruns of flaky network-bound tests.

Merge: squash-merged after approvals and a green CI run with final re-run of safepoint-validate.

Notes: this PR focuses on the CI / release automation and lightweight runtime hooks; a follow-up will add richer sbom linking and an operator UI for safepoint auditing.

f2e7b0c: helm: add values.provenance and templates for safepoint-manifest ingestion

review_comments: Liam O'Rourke: Can we avoid introducing a new GCS path layout? Suggest reusing /releases/<tag>/meta to keep parity with existing tooling. — addressed in follow-up commit: normalized to /releases/<tag>/provenance/

Priya Nair: Need explicit denial for non-cosign-signed manifests in safepoint validator; otherwise an attacker controlling build bucket could inject. — implemented: validator now fails fast unless signature present
Diego Alvarez: terraform state migration could conflict with existing lifecycle rules in some customers; add opt-in variable and docs. — added state_bucket_prefix variable and documentation guidance
Maya Chen (author): replied to all comments and added tests for signature absent scenarios.
release_notes: Adds optional provenance seeding and safepoint manifests to private-installer release pipeline. Provides verifiable rollback safepoints and CI validation for cosign-signed release manifests. Opt-in via values.provenance.enabled. Backfills provenance for two previous release windows.
